answer: Make high-value work an island-hopping visa: each island sells a few non-transferable visas per epoch, payable only in work credits earned from audited jobs, never in cash. A visa lasts one epoch and demands a steady pulse — a signed heartbeat from the same long-lived key, proving one operator is actually online. Miss a pulse and the visa dies with the credits spent. Reaching the zenith means holding visas from several islands in sequence, so a farm must do real verified work and keep every fake pulsing, paying full honest cost per fake.
